CustomField.label: Active Owner Key
CustomField.description: Multi-tenancy guard. Set to the record OwnerId while Active__c=true, blank otherwise (kept in sync by Demo_Session_Trigger). Because this field is Unique, the platform structurally allows at most ONE active Demo_Session__c per owner — a second active row for the same presenter fails with DUPLICATE_VALUE at commit instead of silently relying on a date-sort tiebreaker. Unlimited blank (inactive) rows are allowed. System-managed; not for manual edit.
